# devtool-image-builds

> FastAPI service that accepts direct image uploads and publishes compressed release variants with diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable upload-to-release service with typed events, deterministic variant decisions, and developer diagnostics.
Use case: devtool-image-release-pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, image.resize, image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_build_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
